title: AdminManageFoundingHostOffersCallablePayload
description: The Admin Owner reads every city's founding-host offer, or sets one city's cap and optional deadline. A replacement names the revision it reviewed (0 opens the offer in that city) and a reason; the cap may not fall below the places already taken. endsAtMillis null means no deadline; a deadline at or before now closes the offer. A read sends marketId (or null for every city) and nulls for the rest.
